COMPLICATIONS OF BLOOD TRANSFUSIONS
Complications of blood transfusion
- Immunological:
- Sensitization to red cell antigens
- Haemolytic transfusion reactions
- Immediate
- Delayed
- Reactions due to white cell and platelet antibodies
- Febrile transfusion reactions
- Post-transfusion purpura
- Reactions due to white cell and plasma protein antibodies
- Urticaria
- Anaphylaxis
- Non-immunological:
- Transmission of disease, Reactions due to bacteria and bacterial
pyrogens, Circulatory overload, Thrombophlebitis, Air embolism,
Transfusion haemosiderosis, Complications of massive transfusion
